map.临界角只在什么情况出现？: When does a critical angle appear?
map.临界角只存在于光从光密介质射向光疏介质（n₁>n₂，如水中看空气）；此时入射角超: A critical angle exists only when light travels from an optically denser medium into a rarer one (n₁ > n₂, such as looking at air from under water); beyond θc the light is totally reflected and no refracted ray exists. Going from rare to dense (such as air into water) gives refraction at every angle and no total reflection.
map.钻石折射率 n=2.42，对空气临界角仅 arcsin(1/2.42)=24.4: Diamond has n = 2.42, so its critical angle to air is only arcsin(1/2.42) = 24.4°; even a small angle of incidence causes total internal reflection, so light reflects many times inside before leaving through the top face, and with high dispersion this produces fire. Window glass at n ≈ 1.52 has a critical angle of about 41° and rarely reflects totally.

map.斯涅尔定律折射与全反射: Snell's Law Refraction & Total Internal Reflection
map.sinθ₂ > 1 → 发生全反射，无实数折射角: sinθ₂ > 1 → total internal reflection occurs, with no real refraction angle
map.临界角 θc = asin(n₂ ÷ n₁)，仅当 n₁ > n₂ 时存在: Critical angle θc = asin(n₂ ÷ n₁), existing only when n₁ > n₂
map.入射角 θ₁ > θc 即全反射；θ₁ = θc 时折射角 90°: Total internal reflection occurs when the incidence angle θ₁ > θc; at θ₁ = θc the refraction angle is 90°
map.折射方向：n₂ > n₁ 光从疏介质入密介质，向法线偏折: Refraction direction: when n₂ > n₁, light goes from a less dense to a denser medium and bends toward the normal
map.n₂ < n₁ 光从密介质入疏介质，离法线偏折: When n₂ < n₁, light goes from a denser to a less dense medium and bends away from the normal
map.约束：n₁、n₂ > 0，入射角 0~90°: Constraint: n₁, n₂ > 0 and incidence angle 0–90°
map.分步输出：sinθ₁ → n₁·sinθ₁ → sinθ₂ → θ₂ = asi: Step output: sinθ₁ → n₁·sinθ₁ → sinθ₂ → θ₂ = asin(sinθ₂)
map.斯涅尔定律折射与全反射（角度均相对法线）: Snell's law refraction and total internal reflection (angles measured from the normal)
map.sinθ₂ > 1 → 发生全反射，无折射光；反射角 θr = 入射角 θ₁: sinθ2 > 1 → total internal reflection; no refracted light; reflected angle θr = incident angle θ1
map.θ₁ > θc 即全反射；θ₁ = θc 时折射光沿界面掠射，θ₂ = 90°: θ1 > θc means total internal reflection; at θ1 = θc the refracted ray grazes the interface, θ2 = 90°
map.n₁ = n₂ → 光不偏折，θ₂ = θ₁，无临界角: n1 = n2 → no bending, θ2 = θ1, no critical angle
map.θ₁ = 0° → 垂直入射，光沿法线传播，方向不偏折: θ1 = 0° → normal incidence; light travels along the normal with no direction change
map.n₂ > n₁ → 向法线偏折；n₂ < n₁ → 离法线偏折: n2 > n1 → bends toward the normal; n2 < n1 → bends away from the normal

map.全反射判断：光从高折射率介质射向低折射率介质时，比较入射角与临界角: Total-internal-reflection check: compare incident angle with the critical angle when light goes from a higher to a lower index medium
map.材料对照：查常见介质折射率与对空气临界角；反射角按反射定律等于入射角: Material reference: look up common refractive indices and critical angles against air; the reflected angle equals the incident angle by the law of reflection
map.算法：斯涅尔定律 n₁·sinθ₁=n₂·sinθ₂，θ₂=arcsin(n₁·: Algorithm: Snell's law n1·sinθ1 = n2·sinθ2, θ2 = arcsin(n1·sinθ1/n2). If n1·sinθ1/n2 > 1, total internal reflection occurs, there is no refracted light, and the reflected angle θr = θ1 (both measured from the normal).
map.=arcsin(n₂/n₁)，仅在 n₁&gt;n₂ 时存在；θ₁=θc 时折射: = arcsin(n2/n1), existing only when n1 > n2; at θ1 = θc the refracted ray grazes the interface with θ2 = 90°. When n1 = n2 there is no bending and no critical angle; at θ1 = 0° light is normally incident and travels along the normal. Requires n1, n2 > 0 and 0 ≤ θ1 ≤ 90°.
map.例1（空气 n₁=1.0003 → 水 n₂=1.33，θ₁=30°）：sinθ: Example 1 (air n1=1.0003 → water n2=1.33, θ1=30°): sinθ1=0.5, sinθ2=0.3761, θ2=22.09°; light enters a higher-index medium and bends toward the normal; no critical angle. Example 2 (water n1=1.33 → air n2=1.0003, θ1=50°): sinθ2=1.0185 > 1, total internal reflection occurs, reflected angle θr=50°; critical angle θc=arcsin(1.0003/1.33)=48.77°, and 50° > 48.77°. Example 3 (n1=n2=1.52, θ1=30°): θ2=30°, no bending and no critical angle.
map.全反射时反射角为什么不是 90°？: Why is the reflected angle not 90° during total internal reflection?
map.反射角按反射定律等于入射角，且与入射角以同一法线为基准。90° 是入射角恰好等于: By the law of reflection, the reflected angle equals the incident angle, both measured from the same normal. 90° is the refraction angle when the incident angle exactly equals the critical angle (the refracted ray grazes the interface), not the reflected angle during total internal reflection.
map.临界角只存在于光从高折射率介质射向低折射率介质（n₁&gt;n₂）时；此时 θ₁: A critical angle exists only when light goes from a higher-index to a lower-index medium (n1 > n2); then θ1 > θc gives total internal reflection. With n1 = n2 or n2 > n1, no angle produces total internal reflection.
map.折射率相等或垂直入射怎么判断？: How are equal refractive indices or normal incidence handled?
map.n₁=n₂ 时 θ₂=θ₁，光不偏折，也没有临界角；θ₁=0° 时垂直入射，光沿: When n1 = n2, θ2 = θ1, there is no bending and no critical angle. At θ1 = 0°, light is normally incident and travels along the normal with no direction change. Neither case should be described as entering a lower-index medium and bending.
